characters.description: A Heavens-system Trailblazer stranded in an unfamiliar realm with Selena and Samvek. He protects his companions, retains access to formidable spatial abilities, and begins searching for a route home.
characters.name: Silas

characters.description: Silas’s committed partner, who disguises herself and Samvek as humans while the stranded companions assess the unfamiliar Fae system.
characters.name: Selena

characters.description: An experienced close companion stranded with Silas in an unfamiliar universe. He cannot use his usual teleportation until he learns a destination there.
characters.name: Samvek

characters.description: Silas's trusted Eidolon. The Fae courts bar him from their system, leaving Silas unable to summon him after the party's arrival.
characters.name: Urg

characters.description: The figure associated with manufactured magical goods sold in Basetown. A magical shower at the party's inn bears the Tad's Magical Inventory brand.
characters.name: Tad

characters.description: A strained soul who remains within the necklace artifact Silas carries. The artifact also contains an inaccessible inventory.
characters.name: Lily

characters.description: Samvek's bonded dragon, known through his account of how dragons perceive mana. Their bond informs his understanding of magic even while they are separated.
characters.name: Azuria

characters.description: For three millennia, the Lawgiver has been the only god publicly recognized. His Order enforces that authority and has historically persecuted dissent.
characters.name: The Lawgiver

characters.description: Basetown's experienced Adventurers Guildmaster. After witnessing the outsiders' extraordinary speed and power, he authorizes a high-level assessment in the Endless Dungeon and accompanies them as their local guide.
characters.name: The guildmaster

characters.description: The full name given by the stranded Trailblazer previously known as Silas. A force-based fighter and healer, he enters the Endless Dungeon alongside Selena, Samvek, and the guildmaster.
characters.name: Silas Renner

characters.description: A Grandmaster mage and former adventuring companion of Basetown's guildmaster. His advancement beyond their old party establishes him as an important local figure before he appears directly.
characters.name: Oliver

characters.description: Basetown's Adventurers Guildmaster and the party's oath-bound guide in the Endless Dungeon. He trusts the outsiders with his secrecy and joins their search for a suitable opponent for his advancement.
characters.name: Clay

characters.description: A Fae ruler who sends Silas a recorded treaty offer and asks him to carry her proposal to the Twin Prince.
characters.name: The Winter Queen

characters.description: Tad's illusion-clad lizard companion and fierce protector. She intercepts and kills an Order messenger before it can report the group's location to an inquisitor.
characters.name: Farah

characters.description: Tad's treant companion and a member of the group aboard his living ship. She remains close to him as his new alliance with Silas's group takes shape.
characters.name: Lexa

characters.description: A magical creator and prince of both the Summer and Void courts. Working through the Ways, he can offer an awakening that binds its recipient to him, and Clay knowingly accepts those terms.
characters.name: Tad Ocean

characters.description: Tad's sapient dungeon core. Its awareness makes it a participant in Tad's work rather than a passive magical tool.
characters.name: Spot

characters.description: A relative whom Tad distrusts despite believing that his family may have good intentions.
characters.name: Tad's aunt

characters.description: The ruler of the Void Court and Tad's grandmother. She recognizes Silas as a system mediator and offers temporary insight into Fae-system rules if he helps remove the Order from Basetown.
characters.name: The Void Court queen

characters.description: A demon held through a scepter under Tad's authority. His arrival provokes an uncontrollable response from Samvek's new Hunger, and the group must restrain the clash before negotiating with him.
characters.name: Decimus

characters.description: The Order's Ascendant commander in Basetown. The arbiter captures Silas, recognizes that he comes from another system, and seeks information about his origins and sealed power.
characters.name: The Order arbiter

characters.description: An artificer rescued during the Hall of Nightmares trial. She says she is a human using a gnome avatar from an Earth transformed by an integration, and she recovers her armor and blunderbuss.
characters.name: Violet

characters.description: Silas's blood brother and a distant ally in the Divided Realms. Their established bond makes Ryan one of the important people connected to Silas beyond his immediate circle of companions.
characters.name: Ryan

characters.description: Tad's aunt and an Ascendant princess of the Summer Court. Sent to retrieve her nephew, she tests Silas and Selena in battle before considering their request for help against the Order.
characters.name: Alana

characters.description: A void-aligned fey who holds Tad inside a barrier and has inflicted catastrophic damage on Lexa's core. The captor demands release from both the Court and the Lawgiver in exchange for Tad.
characters.name: The void fey captor
